verdict.rationale: GPU-backend choice is a fair question for a local LLM runtime like Ollama, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a Vulkan backend. The only AMD GPU evidence is about ROCm: ROCm containers, and a log showing Ollama falling back to CPU when no compatible ROCm library is found. That is the opposite of the story's no-ROCm path.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can accelerate inference on AMD GPUs via a Vulkan backend without needing a full ROCm install
